 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Satyavrat Verma
Oral Order

2 10-04-2025 Heard Mr. Sumit Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State and Mr. S.D. Sanjay, learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the Patna Metro Rail Corporation Limited.

2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that the instant writ applications have been filed seeking quashing of the process of acquisition published in the daily newspaper Hindustan dated 23.10.2021 (Annexre- P/22) under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 which has been initiated under the signature of the District Magistrate, Patna with regard to 50.5950 acres of land appertaining to Thana No. 14, Mauza Pahadi, Revenue P.S. Patna City and 25.35 acres of land pertaining to Thana No. 19, Circle Patna Sadar, Mauja Ranipur Revenue P.S. Patna City, District Patna, as such, altogether Patna High Court CWJC No.18400 of 2023(2) dt.10-04-2025 75.96 ares of land tentatively is to be acquired for Project Patna Metro (Rail Depot Corporation) on the ground that the notification dated 23.10.2021 is incorrect, the process is without following the Social Impact Assessment and the action of the authorities is also in violation of Sections 4, 6 and 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Further, to quash the report of the Social Impact Assessment in relation to Patna Metro Rail Depot Corporation Limited (Annexure-P/15) as the same is in complete violation of Sections 4, 6 and 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 and also to quash the formation of the Technical Expert Group under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 dated 23.06.2021 (Annexure-P/16) by which the Expert Committee has been constituted on the ground that the two members at serial no. 6 and 7 have been added as two representatives of the Panchayat, Gram Sabha, Municipality or Municipal Corporation as the case may be but then the Members do not belong to the municipality under which the land is intended to be acquired.

entities.text: Patna Metro Rail Depot Corporation Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Further, to quash the Technical Expert Report under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 (Annexure-P/17) by which Expert Committee has submitted the report on the ground that Section 7(2)(b) of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 has been violated on the face of the Patna High Court CWJC No.18400 of 2023(2) dt.10-04-2025 record and in violation of the intention and objective of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 and other ancillary reliefs.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that persons aggrieved with the acquisition had moved before this Court by filing several writ applications.

One of the writ applications was C.W.J.C. No. 7579 of 2022 and the same was heard analogous with other writ Sanjeev Kumar Alias Sanjeev Ranjan ... vs The State Of Bihar on 10 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50862417/
7 applications and the same came to be decided by a judgment dated 21.12.2023 against which the petitioners of C.W.J.C. No. 7579 of 2022 along with other analogous cases had moved in L.P.A. No.
45 of 2024 which was heard analogous with different L.P.As.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the Patna Metro Rail Corporation Limited also filed different L.P.As. assailing the order of the Writ Court and one of the L.P.As. was L.P.A. No. 315 of 2024.

It is next submitted that even the State of Bihar also assailed the order of the Writ Court by filing several L.P.As. and one of the L.P.As. was L.P.A. No.
321 of 2024.
It is also submitted that the Hon'ble Division Bench tagged all the L.P.As. filed by the aggrieved persons, Patna Metro Rail Corporation Limited and the State of Bihar.
It is submitted that the L.P.A. No. 45 of 2024 was heard analogous with other L.P.As. filed and the order of the Writ Court was modified.

It is further submitted that L.P.As. Patna High Court CWJC No.18400 of 2023(2) dt.10-04-2025 filed by the aggrieved persons were dismissed while the L.P.A. filed by the State of Bihar and the Patna Metro Rail Corporation Limited was allowed with certain modification in the order of the Writ Court.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that petitioners would be satisfied if the instant writ applications are also disposed of in terms of the order dated 27.02.2025 in L.P.A.
No. 45 of 2024 heard analogous with other L.P.As.

5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State and the learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the Patna Metro Rail Corporation Limited do not object to the said submissions made by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners.
6. After haring the learned counsel for the parties, the writ applications are disposed of in terms of the order dated 27.02.2025 in L.P.A. No. 45 of 2024 heard analogous with other L.P.As.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Kundan/-

opennyai_summary.arguments:
2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that the instant writ applications have been filed seeking quashing of the process of acquisition published in the daily newspaper Hindustan dated 23.10.2021 (Annexre- P/22) under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 which has been initiated under the signature of the District Magistrate, Patna with regard to 50.5950 acres of land appertaining to Thana No. 14, Mauza Pahadi, Revenue P.S. Patna City and 25.35 acres of land pertaining to Thana No. 19, Circle Patna Sadar, Mauja Ranipur Revenue P.S. Patna City, District Patna, as such, altogether Patna High Court CWJC No.18400 of 2023(2) dt.10-04-2025 75.96 ares of land tentatively is to be acquired for Project Patna Metro (Rail Depot Corporation) on the ground that the notification dated 23.10.2021 is incorrect, the process is without following the Social Impact Assessment and the action of the authorities is also in violation of Sections 4, 6 and 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013.
5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State and the learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the Patna Metro Rail Corporation Limited do not object to the said submissions made by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners.
opennyai_summary.facts:
Further, to quash the report of the Social Impact Assessment in relation to Patna Metro Rail Depot Corporation Limited (Annexure-P/15) as the same is in complete violation of Sections 4, 6 and 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 and also to quash the formation of the Technical Expert Group under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 dated 23.06.2021 (Annexure-P/16) by which the Expert Committee has been constituted on the ground that the two members at serial no. 6 and 7 have been added as two representatives of the Panchayat, Gram Sabha, Municipality or Municipal Corporation as the case may be but then the Members do not belong to the municipality under which the land is intended to be acquired.
Further, to quash the Technical Expert Report under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 (Annexure-P/17) by which Expert Committee has submitted the report on the ground that Section 7(2)(b) of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 has been violated on the face of the Patna High Court CWJC No.18400 of 2023(2) dt.10-04-2025 record and in violation of the intention and objective of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 and other ancillary reliefs.
It is further submitted that L.P.As. Patna High Court CWJC No.18400 of 2023(2) dt.10-04-2025 filed by the aggrieved persons were dismissed while the L.P.A. filed by the State of Bihar and the Patna Metro Rail Corporation Limited was allowed with certain modification in the order of the Writ Court.
